prds.title: Vault Dashboard requirements
prds.problem: Present note-backed results in a calm overview and drill-down list.
prds.audience: Obsidian users who need adapt for a home view, reading dashboard or project health overview.
prds.goals: Adapt for a home view, reading dashboard or project health overview.
prds.nonGoals:
Implement scoped indexing and result calculation
Choose caching/invalidation; no Dataview dependency is assumed
prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Vault overview
requirements.acceptance: Given the vault overview surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Query results
requirements.acceptance: Given the query results surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Result detail
requirements.acceptance: Given the result detail surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.
